name: Chy mriyutʹ koty pro deruny?
source:
Who says being a cat is an easy job? You can't scratch the wallpaper or sing your favorite songs. But there are advantages! For example, potato pancakes with sour cream! Of course, you have to earn them...

[translated from [url=https://panihannax.itch.io/docatsdream]itch.io[/url]]
